docs.description:
The Riverview Shopping Center Farmers Market (Friant & Ft. Washington) is Fresno's NEWEST California CERTIFIED neighborhood Farmers Market, brought to you by the California Fresh Farmers Market Association. This is the same group that presents the weekly River Park Farmer's Markets.

It operates on Sundays (10 am - 2 pm).

It's now the largest California Certified Farmers Market in our region. It offers a wide variety of seasonal, local, fresh fruits and vegetables, baked goods, and much more! With its close proximity to the east entrance to Woodward park, this farmers market is the perfect place to start or end a refreshing walk in the park.

This farmers market will operate year-round! For more information please visit: https://www.cffma.com/ or call (559) 314-6605

Start your weekend with a run and a great crew! Join Fresno Run Club for our weekly Stride Social — every Saturday at 9 AM at 9407 N Fort Washington, Fresno, CA. 👟☀️

Whether you're training for a race or just want to get your body moving, this run is for all levels and all paces. We'll cover 1–3 miles, then hang around for post-run conversations, coffee, and community vibes. 💬☕️

✨ 1–3 mile run
✨ All paces + experience levels welcome
✨ Great way to meet local runners
✨ Monthly themed runs & pup-friendly events 🐾
✨ Supportive, no-pressure environment

Come solo or bring a friend — everyone is welcome! This is more than just a run… it’s a movement.

Follow us on Instagram for updates and run highlights: @fresnorunclub

Fresno, get ready for a hometown-style night out as Wayne Hancock brings his show to Strummer’s in the heart of the city. Wayne Hancock - Fresno Fresno is set to feel like the kind of live music hang you’ll be talking about all week.

Hancock’s sound blends honky-tonk swing, road-worn storytelling, and sharp musicianship that hits hard and stays catchy. Expect tight rhythms, sly lyrics, and that unmistakable voice that turns every chorus into a singalong.

Strummer’s keeps things close and lively, with great sightlines, an easygoing bar scene, and a central Fresno location that makes arriving and leaving simple. Wayne Hancock - Fresno Strummer's will feel intimate and electric.

Bring your crew, claim your spot, and book your tickets early for Sunday, June 7, 2026 at 7:00 PM.

docs.cms_title_sort: wild wednesdays karaoke party @ bobby salazar's taqueria (tower district) (6979)
docs.description:
🎤 Tower District fam, the wait is over! 🎤 Come out and support the epic return of WILD WEDNESDAYS KARAOKE at Bobby Salazar's Taqueria! 🌟 Reconnect with old friends, make new ones, and create unforgettable memories as we kick off a new era of Wednesday night fun.

Enjoy Bobby's delicious taqueria menu and sip on drink specials while vibing to the hottest club bangers. Whether you're a karaoke pro or just love to cheer on your friends, this is the place to be for the best karaoke experience in Fresno!

📅 Every Wednesday Night
🕢 7:30 PM - 11:30 PM
📍 Bobby Salazar's Taqueria, Tower District

Tag your crew and make plans to join us for a night of singing, dancing, and pure fun. Let's make Wild Wednesdays the highlight of your week! Don't miss out – see you there!
